notEnoughDldTransactions: Not enough DLD transactions to compute reliable market metrics — likely an industrial, emerging, or low-activity district.
thinSampleSalesIn: Thin sample ({{segCount}} sales in 12m) — indicative only
medianTotalDldSale: Median total DLD sale price over the last 12 months — actual deals, not asking prices.
basisNote: Median price & growth count {{basis}} sales only. Off-plan and ready are two different markets — mixing them distorts both; switch basis from the map's top-right toggle. Rental yield, stability and volume always use the full market.
volumeNote: DLD sales in the selected window ({{period}}). Price / yield / growth also follow this window — switch it above.
growthNote: Capital growth over {{period}} = latest rolling median price/㎡ ÷ the window {{period}} earlier − 1 (not point-to-point). {{shortNote}}Insufficient samples show "—".
shortWindowNote: Short windows are thin & volatile — indicative only.
